title: A sustainable spectrofluorimetric method for ivabradine quantification based on erythrosin B quenching with quantum mechanical modeling and Box–Behnken design optimization
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20559-20574
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00744A, Paper
Open Access

Arwa Sultan Alqahtani, Maram H. Abduljabbar, Reem M. Alnemari, Musaad M. Althobaiti, Mohammed F. Aldawsari, Aamal A. Al-Mutairi, Ahmed Serag, Atiah H. Almalki
A novel, highly sensitive spectrofluorimetric method for ivabradine based on erythrosin B quenching was developed and mechanistically validated. The method demonstrated excellent performance with excellent green analytical metrics.
